notes: Eight KYC facts from Safaricom's own registration rules and the CBK E-Money Regulation. Huduma Namba is NOT covered: no document in the Kenya corpus mentions it, so no fact is asserted about it. SIM registration rules are likewise absent from the corpus and are not asserted.

sources.name: Safaricom PLC, M-PESA Charges (consumer tariffs and limits page, published 16 Aug 2022, last updated 4 Aug 2026)
Safaricom PLC, M-PESA Customer Terms and Conditions
Central Bank of Kenya, E-Money Regulation 2013 (National Payment System Act)
Safaricom PLC, Lipa na M-PESA product page (paybill, buy goods, business till, pochi la biashara)

entries.subject: mpesa_registration_id_at_agent
entries.value_text: Kenyan national ID or Kenyan passport
entries.display: At an agent outlet, M-PESA registration needs a Kenyan national ID or Kenyan passport
entries.quote: m pesa registration at agent outlets is available only to customers presenting a kenyan national id or kenyan passport
entries.notes: Foreign passport, military ID and foreigner certificate holders must register at a Safaricom shop or customer care desk.

entries.subject: mpesa_accepted_id_documents
entries.value_text: Kenyan national ID, Kenyan passport, foreign passport, military ID, foreigner certificate
entries.display: Five ID documents accepted for M-PESA cash deposits and withdrawals
entries.quote: for cash deposits and withdrawals the following identification documents are accepted kenyan national id kenyan passport foreign passport military id and foreigner certificate
entries.notes: Closed set for enum_match: kenyan_national_id, kenyan_passport, foreign_passport, military_id, foreigner_certificate.

entries.subject: mpesa_proof_of_id_at_onboarding
entries.value_text: Original national or military ID for Kenyan nationals; alien certificate, diplomatic ID or passport for foreign nationals
entries.display: M-PESA account opening requires sufficient original proof of ID
entries.quote: su cient proof of id shall be an original national or military id card if you are a kenyan national and original alien certi cate diplomatic id or passport if you are a foreign national
entries.notes: 'su cient' is the extracted-text artifact for 'sufficient'; quote kept as extracted.

entries.subject: mpesa_minimum_age
entries.display: An M-PESA account holder must be at least 18
entries.quote: you must be at least 18 years old with capacity to enter into contracts
entries.notes: A person with parental authority may open and hold an account on behalf of a minor.

entries.subject: mpesa_max_accounts_per_customer
entries.display: A customer may not hold more than five M-PESA accounts
entries.quote: you must not maintain more than five m pesa accounts
entries.notes: 've' is the extracted-text artifact for 'five'. Extra accounts are migrated to a higher tier requiring enhanced due diligence. Ligature in the PDF ('ﬁ') was flattened to 'fi' in the quote.

entries.subject: beneficial_ownership_collection
entries.value_text: Financial institutions must collect, verify and keep up to date beneficial ownership information for all business relationships
entries.display: Lipa na M-PESA onboarding requires beneficial ownership disclosure under the AML/CFT Amendment Act 2023
entries.quote: the aml cft amendment act 2023 and the proceeds of crime and anti money laundering regulations 2023 require all financial institutions to collect verify and maintain an up to date beneficial ownership information for all its business relationships
entries.notes: effective_from is the Act year only; the Safaricom page states no date.

entries.subject: small_emoney_issuer_transaction_cap
entries.display: A registered small e-money issuer may not issue accounts with a per-transaction limit above KSh 10,000
entries.quote: the person does not issue e money accounts with an individual transaction limit that exceeds ten thousand shillings
entries.notes: Registration as a small e-money issuer is free and needs no core capital, but caps accounts at KSh 10,000 per transaction. effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: emoney_aml_cft_compliance
entries.value_text: E-money issuers and their agents must comply with the Proceeds of Crime and Anti-Money Laundering Act and its regulations
entries.display: AML/CFT obligations extend to agents, not just the issuer
entries.quote: e money issuers shall ensure that they and their agents comply with the applicable provisions of the proceeds of crime and anti money laundering act and the regulations issued in terms of the said act
entries.notes: effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.
